verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a Data Exports API that triggers export jobs, plus Records and Workflows APIs and document-level read access, so contract data and documents can be pulled out programmatically. However, this access requires the paid API add-on, and nothing shows the formats are open or that the export covers all data. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/PDF specifics), evidence of complete account-wide export, export without the API add-on or a UI export path, offboarding/exit guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
